residual.wall: NST is a raster Gram/AdaIN match. Gasper is a vector organism. Screenshot-stylize would paint a second body and kill the cage.

question: What is neural style transfer, what does it actually match, and what is the lawful analog on a 25×40 vector fabric that must stay a deep glossy purple pearl?
coordinateSpaces: NST lives in pixel / VGG feature space. Gasper lives in content px + 1000-float embeddings + SVG material stops. Do not mix the two writers.
physicalLaw: Gatys 2015/16: I* = argmin_I (α ‖F(I)−F(I_c)‖² + β Σ_ℓ ‖G^ℓ(I)−G^ℓ(I_s)‖²). F = VGG activations (content). G = Gram matrices of those activations (style as second-order channel correlations).
Optimization NST is per-image, hundreds of steps, seconds to minutes. Not a frame budget.
Johnson / Ulyanov 2016: train a feed-forward net per style. Real-time, one style per weight file.
AdaIN (Huang & Belongie 2017): AdaIN(F_c, F_s) = σ(F_s) ((F_c−μ(F_c))/σ(F_c)) + μ(F_s). Match first two channel moments. Arbitrary style, real-time, still raster.
Diffusion / CLIP stylizers (2022–25): stronger semantics, still emit pixels. Not an SVG contour.
Vector NST (2023): applying the same content/style losses to path parameters barely moves drawing style — the structure is the paths, not the Gram of a rasterization.
AdaIN on a scalar field is just moment matching: x' = σ_s (x−μ_c)/σ_c + μ_s. That operation is legal on a 1000-float relief/shade field. It is not legal on a PNG of Gasper.
artisticLaw: Content for Gasper is the cage embedding C = Γ(L)+Σs_i and the face lock. Style is the material packet (pearl, clearcoat, rim, key, optical depth) plus a saved look.
Canonical appearance is not a style you transfer away. Van Gogh-ing the pearl is a species change. Forbidden.
Looks we already save are the style library. loadLook is the stylizer. No VGG.
If we ever 'transfer style' between two Gaspers, match material moments and optional relief AdaIN on the 1000. Do not rasterize.
Screenshot → NST → <image> under #body is a second body. Same crime as cosmic cells and CageShadePass canvas.
invariants: No VGG, ONNX stylizer, or diffusion img2img in the live painter.
No drawImage / foreignObject photo of a styled frame as the hull.
bodyBase stays in the violet well. Looks may tint stops inside that well, not blow to Starry Night.
512 / 25×40 topology unchanged. Style is not a remesh.
Saved looks remain 1000-float embeddings + material coeffs, not PNG styles.
failureModes: Gatys on a capture: 30s+ stall, raster out, W and face become paint.
AdaIN video of the preview: smear, identity loss, no takes, no sockets.
StyleGAN / SD img2img: new creature every frame. Not Gasper.
CSS filter / mix-blend 'style': we already banned screen-blend.
Calling a saved look 'NST' and then adding a CNN anyway.
uncertainty: Whether relief-field AdaIN (moment match on the 1000) is worth a later Explore. Not this cut.
Material-packet lerp between two looks is already almost style transfer. Confirm live loadLook covers it.
Offline research renders (not live) may rasterize for a paper. They must not ship.
tests: No vgg / onnx / tensorflow / style-transfer package in the live painter deps.
Looks API still stores floats (GasperField saveLook), not d and not png.
bodyBase stop colors stay in the violet well after any look load.
visualConsequences: He stays the same organism. A look changes embedding + material, not species.
If he suddenly looks like a painting, someone rasterized.
If he bleaches or pizza-fans, that is the old film dual, not NST.
implementation: Live analog already exists: saveLook / loadLook + material coeffs.
Next implement only if asked: AdaIN on the 1000-float relief/shade field between two saved looks. Still no CNN.
Do not add a style-image upload that runs Gatys.

citations.rule: Content = VGG activations. Style = Gram matrices. Pixel optimization. Raster only.
AdaIN matches μ,σ of feature maps. Real-time arbitrary style. Still feature-map raster.
F:(I_c,I_s)→I_t. Decade of raster pipelines through diffusion. None emit a locked 512 spline.
Standard NST losses barely move vector drawing style; structure is the paths.
Deep glossy purple pearl is identity, not a transferable style.
Looks are 1000-float embeddings. That is our stylizer.
